_comment: Question-side wording variants for the prompt-ensemble readout (reflex.ensemble). The first is the default prompt; the others change headings, the yes/no readout and the ask lines. None touch the state heading or system prompt, so all share one state cache.

variants.choice_ask: Which option fits best? Answer with its letter only.
variants.score_ask: Which level fits best? Answer with its letter only.
